subject: food-technology
title: Wet Cooking
welcome_lead: Boil, simmer, poach, steam — cooking with water.
meta_desc: KS3 food: wet cooking methods explained.
final_note: Water-based methods are healthy and gentle.

concepts.def: Very gentle cooking in hot liquid.
Brief boil then plunge in cold water.

walkthroughs.body_html: Boiling is fast bubbling at 100°C — used for pasta, rice and hard veg. Simmering is gentler bubbles — used for sauces and stocks where boiling would ruin texture.
Poaching is gentle hot liquid — used for delicate eggs and fish. Steaming uses steam above water — keeps more vitamins than boiling.
Blanching = quick boil then ice water — used to keep veg bright. Stewing = slow cooking in liquid for hours — turns tough meat tender.
